title: Encode and compare protocol bytes
responsibility: Provide UTF-8, base64, hashing, random-byte and deterministic JSON helpers for the remote protocol.

inputs.name: stableJson.value
inputs.description: Any JSON-like value to serialize deterministically: object keys are sorted by UTF-16 code unit at every depth, undefined object properties are dropped, and objects are read from their own enumerable keys, so toJSON is never called on them. BigInt values and cyclic structures throw, functions and symbols become null, and sparse array holes become empty elements, which is not valid JSON.

inputs.name: cryptoSource.bytes
inputs.description: The Uint8Array handed to WebCrypto; cryptoSource returns this same object with a type-only cast, so nothing is copied or checked at runtime. sha256 is the only caller in this unit, and it rejects when the value is not a BufferSource.

inputs.name: remoteBytes.text
inputs.description: Text to encode as UTF-8 with TextEncoder; lone surrogates become U+FFFD instead of throwing. Non-ASCII characters take two or more bytes, so the byte length differs from the text length.

inputs.name: bytesText.bytes
inputs.description: Bytes to decode with a fatal UTF-8 decoder, so malformed sequences throw a TypeError instead of becoming U+FFFD; a leading byte order mark is removed from the result.

inputs.name: toBase64.bytes
inputs.description: Bytes to encode as padded standard base64 with + and / characters; the conversion works in 32768-byte chunks, and an empty array gives an empty string.

inputs.name: fromBase64.text
inputs.description: Standard base64 text that may use only A-Z, a-z, 0-9, + and /, must have a length that is a multiple of four, and may carry = padding only at the end; whitespace, unpadded text and other characters throw Error. Non-canonical trailing bits are accepted, and an empty string decodes to an empty array.

inputs.name: toBase64Url.bytes
inputs.description: Bytes to encode as URL-safe base64 as in RFC 4648 section 5, with + and / replaced by - and _ and all = padding removed; an empty array gives an empty string.

inputs.name: fromBase64Url.text
inputs.description: Unpadded URL-safe base64 that may use only A-Z, a-z, 0-9, - and _; text with = padding, + or /, or a length of 1 modulo 4 throws Error. Padding is restored before the strict standard decoder runs, and an empty string decodes to an empty array.

inputs.name: toHex.bytes
inputs.description: Bytes to encode as lowercase hexadecimal, where each byte becomes exactly two characters from 00 to ff; an empty array gives an empty string.

inputs.name: concatBytes.parts
inputs.description: Byte arrays joined in argument order; with no arguments the rest parameter is an empty array, and every part is copied so the result shares no memory with its inputs.

inputs.name: sha256.bytes
inputs.description: Bytes to hash with SHA-256 through crypto.subtle.digest; the returned promise rejects when crypto.subtle is unavailable or the value is not a BufferSource.

inputs.name: randomBytes.length
inputs.description: Number of random bytes to create; fractional values are truncated, negative or infinite values throw RangeError from the Uint8Array constructor, and values above 65536 make crypto.getRandomValues throw QuotaExceededError.

inputs.name: safeEqual.left
inputs.description: First string to compare by UTF-16 code units; when the two lengths differ, the function returns false before it reads any character.

inputs.name: safeEqual.right
inputs.description: Second string to compare; equal-length strings are checked over every character without stopping at the first difference.

outputs.name: cryptoSource
outputs.description: The same Uint8Array object typed as CryptoSource, the BufferSource type that WebCrypto accepts; no bytes are copied and no runtime check runs.

outputs.name: remoteBytes
outputs.description: A new Uint8Array with the UTF-8 encoding of the text, allocated on every call; empty text gives a zero-length array.

outputs.name: bytesText
outputs.description: The decoded text with any leading byte order mark removed; malformed UTF-8 throws a TypeError instead of returning replacement characters.

outputs.name: toBase64
outputs.description: Padded standard base64 text with + and / and = padding to a multiple of four characters; an empty array gives an empty string.

outputs.name: fromBase64
outputs.description: A new Uint8Array of the bytes decoded from text that already passed the strict base64 check; an empty string gives a zero-length array.

outputs.name: toBase64Url
outputs.description: URL-safe base64 text with - and _ in place of + and / and no = padding; an empty array gives an empty string.

outputs.name: fromBase64Url
outputs.description: A new Uint8Array of the bytes decoded from the unpadded URL-safe text after its padding is restored; an empty string gives a zero-length array.

outputs.name: toHex
outputs.description: Lowercase hexadecimal text with exactly two characters per byte, so its length is twice the byte length; an empty array gives an empty string.

outputs.name: concatBytes
outputs.description: A new Uint8Array holding all parts in argument order, with a length equal to the sum of the part lengths; no arguments give a zero-length array.

outputs.name: sha256
outputs.description: A promise that resolves to the 32-byte SHA-256 digest of the input and rejects instead when crypto.subtle.digest fails.

outputs.name: randomBytes
outputs.description: A new Uint8Array of the requested length, filled in place by crypto.getRandomValues with cryptographically random values; the call is synchronous.

outputs.name: safeEqual
outputs.description: True only when both strings have the same length and identical UTF-16 code units; a length mismatch returns false before any character is compared.

outputs.name: stableJson
outputs.description: JSON text of the value with object keys sorted at every depth and undefined object properties omitted, while undefined array elements, functions, symbols, NaN and Infinity are written as null. BigInt and cyclic input throw instead of producing text.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown by fromBase64 for text that is not strict standard base64, and by fromBase64Url for text outside the URL-safe alphabet or with a length of 1 modulo 4.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown by bytesText for malformed UTF-8 and by stableJson for a BigInt value, which JSON.stringify refuses; sha256 rejects with it when its argument is not a BufferSource or crypto.subtle is unavailable.

errors.name: RangeError
errors.description: Thrown by randomBytes for a negative or infinite length, from the Uint8Array constructor, and by stableJson for a cyclic structure, where the recursion exhausts the call stack.

errors.name: QuotaExceededError
errors.description: DOMException thrown by crypto.getRandomValues inside randomBytes when the requested length is above 65536 bytes.

errors.name: OperationError
errors.description: DOMException that sha256 rejects with when the WebCrypto digest operation itself fails; the code does not catch or translate it.
